  NODE = Connection traversing PCIe as well as the interconnect between PCIe Host Bridges within a NUMA node
  PHB  = Connection traversing PCIe as well as a PCIe Host Bridge (typically the CPU)
  PXB  = Connection traversing multiple PCIe bridges (without traversing the PCIe Host Bridge)
  PIX  = Connection traversing at most a single PCIe bridge
  NV#  = Connection traversing a bonded set of # NVLinks

answer_scoring.scope: tokens before the first configured stop token
answer_scoring.reason: When fixed-length generation continues past a stop token, hidden special markers can concatenate the answer with a later turn and cause a false word-boundary mismatch. All runs are rescored consistently from token IDs.

dense-vllm.scoring_policy: Decode tokens before the first configured stop token, then match the expected whole six-digit code. Raw full-output checks are preserved.

dense-exllamav3.scoring_policy: Decode tokens before the first configured stop token, then match the expected whole six-digit code. Raw full-output checks are preserved.

moe-vllm.scoring_policy: Decode tokens before the first configured stop token, then match the expected whole six-digit code. Raw full-output checks are preserved.

moe-exllamav3.scoring_policy: Decode tokens before the first configured stop token, then match the expected whole six-digit code. Raw full-output checks are preserved.

interpretation: Prefill stage wall time includes first-token work and engine overhead; batch metric is maximum per-request TTFT. Retrieval matching is a basic functional check, with repeated prompts, not a broad long-context accuracy benchmark.
